description:
Read any public web page and get its visible text back: the words a person would see, with navigation and boilerplate stripped, plus the title and final URL after redirects. JavaScript pages are rendered in a real browser first. Up to 50,000 characters.

Use it to read an article, a doc, a policy or any page you were given a link to. Chain it with a summarizer when the page is long.

$0.005 USDC per page over x402. A page that fails to load, returns an error or has no text costs nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public page.

name: read_page
title: Read a web page as clean text
